name: Pussies & Dragons
source:
Adult Visual Novel about four anthro felines,  talking about their sex and romantic life. Pick your favorite or follow all four girls as their relationships with dragon/scalie partners unfold. 

[From [url=https://elvche.itch.io/pussies-dragons]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
关于四只人类猫科动物的成人视觉小说，谈论它们的性和浪漫生活。选择你最喜欢的，或关注所有四个女孩，了解她们与龙/鳞片伴侣的关系。

[来自[url=https://elvche.itch.io/pussies-dragons]itch.io[/url]]
